# Rani Tours

> Rani Tours is a Jodhpur, Rajasthan travel company providing taxi services, customizable Rajasthan and India tour packages, destination planning, corporate transport, and group travel using cars, Tempo Travellers, and buses.

Use the public pages below as the authoritative website sources. Taxi services and tour packages are enquiry-based; the website does not provide online booking or public fixed taxi pricing. Availability and final travel arrangements are confirmed by Rani Tours.

## Main

- [Home](https://www.ranitour.in/): Overview of Rani Tours, its travel services, destinations and enquiry options.
- [About](https://www.ranitour.in/about): Information about Rani Tours and its travel services from Jodhpur.
- [Contact](https://www.ranitour.in/contact): Official contact and enquiry information.
- [Get a Quote](https://www.ranitour.in/get-quote): Request a custom quote for a taxi, tour or group journey.
- [FAQ](https://www.ranitour.in/faq): Answers to common questions about taxis, tours, payments, vehicles, corporate travel and destinations.

## Taxi Services

- [Taxi Services](https://www.ranitour.in/taxi-services): Published local, outstation, transfer, corporate and group taxi services.
- [Fleet](https://www.ranitour.in/fleet): Cars, SUVs, Tempo Travellers, buses and other available vehicle categories.
- [Corporate Travel](https://www.ranitour.in/corporate): Corporate, employee, executive, airport and business transport services.

## Tours and Destinations

- [Tour Packages](https://www.ranitour.in/tour-packages): Customizable Rajasthan and India tour packages.
- [Destinations](https://www.ranitour.in/destinations): Rajasthan and India destinations, regions and travel themes.
- [Gallery](https://www.ranitour.in/gallery): Travel, destination and fleet imagery published by Rani Tours.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.ranitour.in/privacy-policy): How personal information submitted through the website is handled.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.ranitour.in/terms-and-conditions): Terms governing enquiries, quotations and travel services.
- [Cancellation Policy](https://www.ranitour.in/cancellation-policy): General cancellation, modification and refund policy.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://www.ranitour.in/sitemap.xml): Index of public static pages and published CMS taxi services, tour packages and destinations.
- [Robots](https://www.ranitour.in/robots.txt): Crawler access policy. Admin and API routes are not public content.
